title: Preclinical Cardiomyopathy and Autonomic Function in Type 1 Diabetes
brief_summary: Type 1 diabetes mellitus is a chronic autoimmune disease, associated with an increased risk of cardiovascular diseases. The development of cardiomyopathy in type 1 diabetes, independent of hypertension and coronary heart disease, is still controversial. A possible mechanism for diabetic cardiomyopathy is autonomic dysfunction. This study aims to evaluate cardiac function and structure, and to relate them with autonomic dysfunction in type 1 diabetes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* type 1 diabetes mellitus

Exclusion Criteria:

* hypertension
* coronary artery disease
* heart valve disease
* ventricular dysfunction
* radiotherapy or chemotherapy
* alcoholism
* limited acoustic window
study_population: Selection of patients from a tertiary hospital.
